name: Elissavet Vozemberg-Vrionidi - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Agreement between the European Union and Ukraine amending the Agreement between the European Union and Ukraine on the carriage of freight by road of 29 June 2022
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should approve an updated deal with Ukraine on carrying goods by road. This deal amends an earlier agreement from 29 June 2022. Parliament is not proposing new rules itself. It is giving its consent, which is needed before the agreement can be concluded on the Union's behalf. Once approved, the amended terms will apply to road freight transport between the EU and Ukraine.

- The EU-Ukraine road freight agreement of 2022 is amended; Parliament consents to the change.
- It affects hauliers and businesses moving goods by road between the EU and Ukraine.
- The Council can now conclude the agreement; the amended terms then apply.
